ROOT CAUSE: task-logs and llama_server.log show three 8-slot llama-servers packed onto one L4 concurrently; per-token throughput collapsed from ~18 tok/s early to ~0.28 tok/s at the busiest overlap, individual HTTP requests to two of the three arms timed out, and gen_gguf.py's request path folds a timeout into a silent empty-string completion with no retry and no abort (only the first 5 per-arm failures are even logged). pack_gb's VRAM ceilings (8/4/4 of 24 GB) do nothing to arbitrate GPU *compute*, and set_per_process_memory_fraction doesn't reach a llama.cpp child at all -- so three arms fit on paper and starved each other in practice. DISPOSITION: not promoting R3-F16 or R3-Q4_0 from this job. R3-Q4_K_M is a candidate for promotion once its clean-arm status is corroborated (it ran alone for the bulk of the window, but wasn't literally alone from t=0). Charged in full to budget.json (0.556 GPU-h) -- compute was genuinely spent even though 2 of 3 arms aren't usable. Relaunch: R3-F16 requeued solo as ba294aa7 (attempt 3).
